The new legacy completed-task test covers runtime generation only, not the SQL backfill.

Transactional interleavings: all feature cases use one enclosing @Transactional test and sequential calls. Add a bounded two-connection MySQL regression for update/pause racing confirmation or generation, asserting the old version cannot commit a confirmation after cancellation and generated tasks belong to the committed version. Existing sequential assertions do not verify the newly introduced plan-before-task lock discipline.
